_doc: One table for the shared shadow output, read by BOTH twins: src/utils/shadow-output.js (tests/js/shadow-output.test.js) and includes/helpers-shadow-filter.php::sgs_shadow_decl_map (tests/php/run-shadow-filter-standalone.php). `shape` and `colour` are composed first (sgs_shadow_layers / composeShadow); `followShape` picks box mode or follow-the-shape mode; `expected` is the declaration map. `presets` is the theme's shadow presets, as the PHP test stubs wp_get_global_settings and the JS test registers them.

presets.shadow: 0px 1px 2px 0px color-mix(in srgb, var(--wp--custom--shadow-colour) 10%, transparent), 0px 0px 0px 1px color-mix(in srgb, var(--wp--custom--shadow-colour) 5%, transparent)

cases.name: box: one layer prints box-shadow and the forced-colours fallback
follow: one layer prints a drop-shadow with no spread and no fallback
follow: layers chain, each with its own colour
follow: an inset layer is skipped
follow: an inset-only shadow draws nothing
box: none prints none with no fallback
an empty shape draws nothing in either mode
box: a preset stays a reference
follow: a multi-layer preset is read from the theme, hex colours, chained
follow: a preset written with color-mix keeps it, layer by layer

expected.filter: drop-shadow(0px 1px 2px color-mix(in srgb, var(--wp--custom--shadow-colour) 10%, transparent)) drop-shadow(0px 0px 0px color-mix(in srgb, var(--wp--custom--shadow-colour) 5%, transparent))

cases.name: follow: an inset-only preset draws nothing
follow: an unknown preset draws nothing, not invalid CSS
